market: Ireland-facing Apple Support source; shared model identification page
source_policy: Use official Apple URLs that identify the product/model. Do not create separate product records solely for case size, finish, GPS vs GPS + Cellular, or branded editions unless TechSpecs presentation later needs them as meaningful variants.

sources.purpose: Official model-identification index covering Apple Watch generations, editions and model numbers
sources.notes: Ireland URL is the intended locale. Search-indexed Apple Support content currently exposes the page via the UK and other regional variants; this exact Ireland URL should be confirmed by the scraper before being marked content_verified.

notes: This is the first pass, not a claim that every Apple Watch family or every official Tech Specs URL has been discovered.
Apple Watch model identification pages include case sizes, finishes, GPS/cellular variants and special editions. These should not automatically become separate TechSpecs product records.
Next step is to collect official Apple product/specification URLs and create the first model records in schema v2.0.
